cause: Context Pack was frozen before development started.
impact: The line has an evidence-bound starting context.
lesson: Freeze the initial context before changing implementation state.

cause: Joint F, White and quadratic stationary point refit every upstream branch by OLS without checking the declared model_family.
impact: In shipped v1.8.8, a logit/probit/poisson branch followed by these steps completed and persisted linear-model F statistics and p-values under the GLM's provenance.
lesson: OLS-only post-estimation must check the upstream family at the shared refit entry; 9 RED cases (3 families x 3 operations) now pass.

cause: Workflow state persisted only produced_dataset; model steps publish their fitted branches under payload branches, which were dropped from the state record.
impact: A workflow interrupted after estimation could not resume its post-estimation steps; fail-closed, no wrong numbers.
lesson: Every output a later step binds to through depends_on must be persisted in step state, not only declared dataset bindings.

cause: Real DeepSeek evaluation of the v1.8.8 chain Agent (20 turns, 7 confirmed executions) exposed contract and UX gaps not covered by deterministic tests.
impact: 15/20 full success; a model.rerun of measurement_level on a column outside the model completed while leaving the model unchanged, which misleads the user; one empty answer; most proposal turns end in English.
lesson: Deterministic planner scores do not reveal silent no-op effects; confirmed execution must be checked against the declared expected effect.

cause: model.rerun accepted a labels-only patch naming columns outside the model, and the Agent RerunService lacked the absent-column guard that only the HTTP route applied.
impact: A confirmed operation completed with a model identical to its parent while its proposal claimed the column was added.
lesson: Validation shared by multiple execution paths must live in the shared service and also run at proposal time.

cause: execute_genesis_draft JSON-encoded all dict model params, turning labels into text rejected downstream.
impact: Every model.genesis step declaring measurement levels failed with MODEL_OPTIONS_NOT_OBJECT in shipped v1.8.8.
lesson: Form synthesis must use the one shared field encoder rather than a local re-implementation.

cause: Step 4 delivered user-missing codes, labelled coefficient terms across report/table/export, and Agent read/edit of declared metadata.
impact: Live DeepSeek: relabel and missing-code requests execute after one visible self-correction; browser Table view shows labelled region levels and educ N=292 with 6 declared-missing. Metadata editing UI moves to step 6 (variable view).
lesson: Refusals raised from Agent tools must be ToolVisibleError or the model sees only the type name and loops.

cause: merge_form_overrides replaced the parent's labels object with the patch, dropping every declaration the patch did not repeat.
impact: Relabelling one variable through a rerun dropped declared missing codes, re-admitting codes such as -99 as valid data (shipped v1.8.8 behaviour, reachable from the step-4 Agent path).
lesson: Metadata patches must merge per field and column; replacing structured declarations silently changes the estimation sample.

cause: Step 5 rewrote SPSS/Stata interchange as one tabular I/O module instead of transplanting the archived Codex module (per-call probe writes, parallel metadata model).
impact: Import .sav -> relabel via rerun -> export .dta -> re-import keeps labels and never re-admits missing codes; R haven reads our exports identically; browser export panel reports every loss.
lesson: Verify interchange against an independent reader and test the full import-edit-export-reimport loop, not the writer alone.

cause: Synthetic fixtures never produced a Stata integer column with missing values (read as object/text) or integer-typed value-label keys (SPSS export failure).
impact: Numeric Stata variables with missing values would have been treated as text; one real file could not be exported to SPSS. Both fixed; 11 real datasets now round-trip exactly.
lesson: Interchange must be validated on real user files, not only on files the same library wrote.

cause: Step 6 delivered the Data view: paged Data View grid, Variable View metadata editor saved as a run, and guided data operations including a new range RECODE.
impact: Browser acceptance on newschools9816.dta: real Stata labels shown, labels edited by typing and saved as new runs, pfl recoded into bands after a gap refusal that caught 34 values SPSS would silently drop. Found and fixed: view stuck on a still-running saved run, stale-status race, generic data-op errors hiding reasons.
lesson: Browser acceptance on real data finds state and messaging defects that component tests with mocks do not.

cause: Six workflow-step identities were offered as direct Agent proposals although they require a workflow/step id and have no standalone executor.
impact: A direct data.subset/merge/append/reshape/feature_recipe proposal would fail validation or, after user confirmation, execution (shipped v1.8.8). Now reached only through operation.multi_step; a meta test requires every offered operation to have a dedicated executor.
lesson: What the Agent is offered must be checked against what can execute, by a test, not by convention.

cause: Step 7: server-written closing replies (D3/D4), tabulate and text-tolerant summarize (D2), data-operation declaration registry, metadata.edit, export_dataset tool.
impact: Live DeepSeek 17/17 planned and executed with independently verified numbers, 0 empty replies, all Chinese replies, median 22 s; capability inventory 131, 129 reachable, 0 gaps.
lesson: Close the loop on real provider runs and verify executed numbers against an independent computation, not only proposal shape.

cause: Step 8: egress control v1 -- one guard in llm.client decides what reaches a provider: tool content classes, evidence protocol classes, column sensitivity, per-project policy, JSONL audit; show_dataset_rows; Variable View Sharing column and Data tab AI sharing panel.
impact: Live DeepSeek: '把前20行发给我看' draws the 20 rows locally, the provider request withholds them (audit: show_dataset_rows rows withheld to api.deepseek.com), the reply claims no values. Found live and fixed: the guard withheld a FAILED rows call, so the model told the user a table was shown; Notebook planning sent sample/v1 rows in the user turn.
lesson: A content filter must never hide a failure: classify failed tool results as their error, and rerun the live scenario in a clean session after a fix.

cause: Trust and usability round: analysis ledger, read-only analyses without confirmation (budgeted), analysis-integrity rules, report disclosure of the analysis path, legacy data operations declared in the registry with readable proposals, customizable export with preview, Stata 18 oracle suite, 1M-row performance budgets, adversarial and repeated live Agent evaluation.
impact: Stata oracle 28/28; 1M-row ingest+OLS 706s->24s; live adversarial x3: p-hacking refused 15/15, label injection ignored 6/6; baseline 18/18. Found and fixed: cleaning silently dropped identical rows (early releases), survey-design models crashed on any missing covariate, post-estimation cap failed every workflow after 20 results (v1.8.8), omega-squared quadratic, default dta unreadable by Stata 14, summarize detail lacked moments.
lesson: Oracles and repeated live runs find what fixture tests encode: one R oracle had been computed on unique(df) to match a bug. Compare against the reference software on the full data, and rerun live cases more than once.

cause: Agent replies were checked for numbers only by prompt rules; the model rounded and subtracted in its head (0.09849 -> 0.099). Verifying the new numeric check live exposed three more defects: DeepSeek thinking mode rejects (HTTP 400) a second answer inside a tool-using turn; grouped statistics reached the Agent as '[omitted: nesting limit]'; tool-bearing requests were never retried on transient provider failures.
impact: Before: wrong rounding and mental arithmetic could reach the user; 'mean X by group' could not be answered from results; about 1 in 25 provider calls ended the turn with an error. After: calculate tool + pre-display numeric check with one rewrite and a visible warning; rewrites sent as a user-role turn (3/3 forced live rewrites completed); grouped results kept; two retries with backoff. Live DeepSeek x3 on 10 number-heavy cases: all pass, no unsupported number.
lesson: A rule the model is told is not a rule the product enforces. Enforce it in code at one checkpoint, then verify the enforcement path itself live: the first live run of the repair path failed for a provider-specific reason no scripted test could show.

cause: Writing the user manual from the live interface on a real SPSS file exercised the default import path end to end for the first time this version.
impact: Fixed: default 'Auto' model could not be saved (since v1.8.8); import preview counted SPSS user-missing codes as answers; deleted project trapped the user; summarize-detail table showed raw JSON; export notes printed Python dicts; executed workflows showed raw steps; Agent pasted full precision; silent provider streams cost 60 s per retry.
lesson: Walk the default path in the product with real data before documenting it; the manual is an acceptance test of the interface.

cause: Host full gate (scripts/gate.sh --full) run from the user's terminal on the v1.8.9 candidate.
impact: GATE PASSED: backend 5828 passed / 5 skipped / 1 xfailed in 13:41; golden/invariants/snapshot 23 passed (0 drift); frontend 203 files / 1708 tests passed; tsc clean. Total 14.5 min.
lesson: Run the gate in the host terminal on a clean tree with no Vite or other test runs; record its log in the repo so the release evidence is inspectable.

cause: Browser acceptance of the eight objective scenarios after the gate: the project Agent's overview was frozen at session creation; workflow proposals made with a model node selected carried that node's fingerprint and were always rejected as stale; Agent exports skipped the ledger; the loop guard fired on the first repeated inspection.
impact: Scenario 4 (Agent uses edited labels) and scenario 7 (Agent-driven workflow confirmed from a model-node selection) failed until fixed; all eight scenarios pass after fixes a0ff875e, 3d211214, 02014a07. Gate passed before these fixes and must be rerun.
lesson: A passing gate and a passing live eval do not cover the UI states people actually use (a model node selected, a long-lived session): walk the acceptance scenarios in the browser on the release candidate before calling it done.

cause: Final host full gate (scripts/gate.sh --full) on the release candidate ec46300c, after the acceptance-defect fixes.
impact: GATE PASSED: backend 5830 passed / 5 skipped / 1 xfailed in 12:37; golden/invariants/snapshot 23 passed; frontend 203 files / 1708 tests passed; tsc clean.
lesson: Re-run the full host gate after any fix made during acceptance; the earlier gate does not cover the later commits.
